4.name: Elune's Light
4.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

4.name: Quickness
4.text: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

4.name: Wisp Spirit
4.text: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.
